frozen_before: any download of price history, moving average, signal or return statistic

series_rule: Use the executable product's own Yahoo Finance series when it starts on or before 2008-12-31; otherwise use the US-listed ETF that tracks the same index as the product. The rule is mechanical and does not depend on returns.

series_rule_conditions.a_same_index_or_exclude: If no US-listed ETF tracks the product's own index, the asset is excluded; it is never replaced by a similar index. Checked mechanically: a proxy's 'tracks' must equal the product's 'tracks'.
series_rule_conditions.b_known_at_decision: The signal and the EUR conversion use only values published before D(T) = 23:00 Europe/Lisbon. The US close (16:00 New York = 20:00-21:00 Lisbon) is later than the Xetra close (17:30 CET) and the ECB rate (~16:00 CET), and all three precede D(T) on every day, including the weeks when US and EU daylight-saving dates differ.
series_rule_conditions.c_ter_difference: A US ETF proxy already contains its own TER; its daily return is adjusted by (TER_us - TER_eu) / 365 per calendar day so that the realistic scenario carries exactly the executable product's TER.

questions: COMMOD: the only long US history of the Bloomberg Commodity Index TR is DJP, an ETN (Barclays note), not an ETF.

known_limitations: US-listed proxies trade during US hours (Xetra products trade during European hours); converted with the ECB rate published before the US close.
US-listed proxies pay dividends gross of the 15% US withholding that Irish UCITS funds suffer; not adjusted (no new parameter).
DJP is an ETN (issuer credit risk); used only as a history of the Bloomberg Commodity total-return index.
Spreads and slippage are constant estimates; historical spreads (e.g. 2009-2012) were likely wider.
US proxy TERs are held constant at their 2026-11-14 values over the whole history; past TERs differed (usually higher).
IBKR pays no interest on the first EUR 10,000 of cash and benchmark minus 0.5 p.p. above it (secondary-source snapshot); the protocol's cash rate is EUR STR minus 0.25 p.p. for every capital.
